design.title: More base around the reference conditions
assumptions: 'Our usual conditions' read as the reference control: catalyst 2.0 mol %, base 1.5 equivalents, 20% co-solvent.
'More base' read as base from 1.5 up to 3.0 equivalents in 0.5 steps.
Controls on: negative and reference controls in A1 to D1 (assay default).
